data.title: 幽灵鲨 · 潮音白石阶上的咏叹
data.action: 优雅单手提着微湿的黑白裙摆，一步步踏入清凉海水，另一只手轻抚过长卷银发，嘴角挂着难以捉摸而优雅沉醉的微笑，微微昂首倾听潮鸣
data.location: 临海旧教堂废墟坍塌入海的白大理石台阶
data.lighting: 晨雾中穿透的冷冽天光与微弱暖曦
data.camera: 戏剧化远景与中景交错，大理石残柱与海水构成古典油画感
data.mood: 优雅癫狂、哥特神秘、唯美从容
data.description: 旧日海滨教堂废墟的破晓清晨。幽灵鲨身着深渊雕塑家复古修女风束腰泳裙，提着荷叶裙摆缓缓步入海浪。清冷晨雾从海面蒸腾，她轻抚微湿的银色卷发，倾听着潮水拍打残柱的声响，笑容中兼具艺术家的狂热与深海血脉的幽玄。
promptTokens: black and alabaster white layered fabrics
wading on submerged white marble steps
lifting skirt hem with one hand
red eyes with dreamy artistic smile
data.promptProse: Specter descending into the surging tide along the submerged white marble steps of a ruined seaside chapel. She is adorned in an exquisite gothic nun-inspired corset swimdress of contrasting black and alabaster white with delicate lace trims. Holding her damp ruffled skirt hem daintily, she strokes her long wavy silver locks with an enigmatic, rapturous smile as dawn mist envelops the sea.
